summary: Steel tower of 85 ft erected a mile east of Pembroke in 1928, per a state report; no source found on its fate or today's site.

facts.agency: North Carolina Division of Forest Resources

events.note: Steel tower erected one mile east of Pembroke, per the 1928-30 state report quoted on the page

evidence.supports: 1928 steel tower, 85 ft, erected one mile east of Pembroke (also the height and design)
evidence.quote: An 85-foot steel tower was erected one mile east of Pembroke.

evidence.supports: Poles set for a two-mile line linking the tower to the local telephone company
evidence.quote: Poles have been set for two miles of metallic circuit line to connect the Pembroke tower with the local telephone company in Pembroke, Robeson County.

evidence.supports: January 1930 newspaper gives an 80-foot tower at Pembroke
evidence.quote: The county has an 80-foot tower at Pembroke.

evidence.supports: February 1930: poles placed on the ground in preparation for extending the telephone line to the lookout, which is on the school property
evidence.quote: which is located on the Pembroke consolidated school property.

evidence.supports: Agency listed for the North Carolina section of the page
evidence.quote: North Carolina Division of Forest Resources

notes_for_editor: All facts come from one compiled page that quotes a 1928-30 state report and two 1930 Robesonian items. Sources disagree on height (85 ft in the state report, 80 ft in the newspaper) and on location (one mile east of town vs the school property); neither is resolved. The February 1930 item says poles had been placed in preparation for extending the line, not that the extension was under way; the story now says so. No source read gives the tower's fate or its status today, so status is left unset. Waymarking listing WM195W (Pembroke Fire Tower, Robeson County, posted 2007) turned up in search, but its page text did not load, so it is not used. Search used 2 WebSearch calls. A Robesonian archive check or an NC Division of Forest Resources inquiry would be the next step.
